title: The Battle of Hogwarts — 2 May, Never Forgotten
description:
On this day, bravery meant standing your ground even when fear took over. From Fred Weasley’s laughter to Snape’s truth, the Battle of Hogwarts wasn’t just a fight — it was a turning point.
“If not us, who? If not now, when?”
🖤 Always remember the fallen.

title: Slytherin: Ambition Is Not a Crime
description:
Cunning. Resourceful. Determined. Slytherins are often misunderstood, but their ambition is what shapes leaders and changemakers. Not every serpent is dark — some just know exactly what they want.
Would you dare to wear green and silver? 💚

title: The Magic of Patronuses
description:
A Patronus is more than a spell — it’s a reflection of your soul. Harry’s stag, Hermione’s otter, Snape’s doe… each tells a story of love, loss, and hope.
✨ If you could cast a Patronus, what form would it take?
